method: Every decoded frame inspected in fifteen ordered contact sheets; enlarged selected PNGs also inspected. Not real-time playback or artist approval.
contact_sheet_limit: Thumbnail resize distorts aspect and loses fine detail; full PNGs were also inspected.

videos.finding: Moving-reflection tests reconstruct supported texture with native interpolation loss. Fixed-to-material reflection yields purple unsupported pixels in the correct model. These are synthetic test diagrams, not photorealistic eyes.
The original reflection remains on rejected frames. Partly weighted reliable frames retain a dimmed reflection. No claim that the taper makes transitions imperceptible.

Both halves preserve the same reporter eyes, including softbox reflections, blinks and changing head pose. Every real frame deliberately takes fallback; no automatic reliable-view classification or repaired reporter is shown.

prior_native_source_inspection.finding: Native crops show eye-pose and reflection changes. This inspection does not certify clean donors at covered iris material locations.

artist_decisions: The tool must accept varied input videos; reporter diagnostics do not define its general limits.
Use other frames of the same iris for reconstruction where reliable.
Keep original keyed eyes and any catchlight on unreliable frames or angles.
